tips_en: Start with the unified multimodal pretraining paper (Paper 2) — its systematic findings on asymmetric knowledge flow between language understanding and visual generation provide foundational insights that resonate with both other works. WorldClaw (Paper 1) demonstrates these principles in action through its decoupled agentic pipeline that separates global planning from local generation, while GST-Bench (Paper 3) exposes the practical consequences: current VLMs still struggle with the kind of global spatial coherence that Papers 1 and 2 aim to build.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读统一多模态预训练论文（论文2）——其关于语言理解与视觉生成之间非对称知识流动的系统性发现，为另外两篇论文提供了基础性洞见。WorldClaw（论文1）通过将全局规划与局部生成解耦的智能体流程实践了这些原理，而GST-Bench（论文3）则揭示了实际后果：当前VLM在论文1和论文2试图构建的全局空间一致性方面仍有明显不足。
